    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    k = int(input[1])
    droids = []
    index = 2
    for i in range(n - 1):
        row = list(map(int, input[index:index + n - i - 1]))
        droids.append(row)
        index += n - i - 1

    graph = {}
    for i in range(n):
        graph[i] = {}

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if droids[i][j - i - 1] != -1:
                graph[i][j] = droids[i][j - i - 1]
                graph[j][i] = droids[i][j - i - 1]

    def find_adjacent_set(s):
        for node in range(n):
            if all(node in graph[silo] for silo in s):
                return node
        return None

    total_danger = 0
    count = 0
    for s in combinations(range(n), k):
        adjacent = find_adjacent_set(s)
        if adjacent is not None:
            danger = sum(graph[silo][adjacent] for silo in s)
            total_danger += danger
            count += 1

    average_danger = total_danger // count
    print(average_danger)
